scope: Bounded structural proof/counterexample assay, not a search campaign
claim: A plant-derived Grassmannian linear section represents all full-feedthrough gains; for exactly two inputs and two measured outputs, unstabilized synthesis is completely reduced to one classified real quadric after linear elimination.
nonclaims: General stable synthesis without residual feasibility
frozen_checks: Recheck the existing no-greatest-subspace witness exactly before using any lattice assumption

Compare determinant-minor coefficient maps with an independently constructed adjugate transfer numerator and full characteristic polynomial for all symbolic gains on fixed dense full-feedthrough and rectangular-gain fixtures
Derive every gain of the two-state continuum plant and its strict stable interval
Derive an explicit four-state real-infeasible but complex-feasible plant with residual equation a^2+1=0
Check hidden modes at -1, 0, +1 using the full characteristic polynomial
Exercise every exact quadratic-classification branch, including singular and zero-dimensional cases
Check exact feasible witnesses and independent infeasibility certificates
independent_review: Other-vendor Claude CLI, registry-selected model/effort; supplied mathematical text only, no tools or further delegation
stop_rule: One decisive verifier run after proof and code stabilize; fix genuine failures before acceptance, retaining any failed output. No random or exhaustive plant sweep.
